title: Dyad: Extending Large Language Models with Native Typed Decision-Making
abstract: arXiv:2609.36116v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how to build more capable general-purpose agents by extending large language models (LLMs) with native typed decision-making. We introduce Dyad, an architecture that augments a pretrained LLM with an environment-conditioned action encoder that embeds each candidate action description in parallel, then scores these embeddings against the LLM's internal state to yield a distribution over typed actions. By factorizing decision-making into representations of the evolving interaction state and environment-specific action semantics, Dyad introduces an inductive bias for learning reusable representations while keeping action scoring efficient even as the action space grows. We investigate two complementary reinforcement learning settings driven by environment interaction. translated_title: Dyad：通过原生类型化决策扩展大型语言模型
translated_abstract: 我们研究如何通过为大语言模型（LLM）扩展原生类型化决策能力，来构建更强大的通用智能体。我们提出了Dyad，这是一种架构，它通过环境条件化的动作编码器来增强预训练的LLM，该编码器并行地嵌入每个候选动作描述，然后将这些嵌入与LLM的内部状态进行评分比对，从而生成类型化动作上的分布。通过将决策过程分解为对不断演变的交互状态的表示与环境特定的动作语义，Dyad引入了一种用于学习可复用表示的归纳偏置，同时即使动作空间不断增长，也能保持动作评分的高效性。我们研究了由环境交互驱动的两种互补的强化学习设置。在LLM冻结的情况下，仅训练动作编码器即可在四个未见过的环境中取得一致的增益，从而实现无需修改任何LLM参数的模块化适配。
tldr: Dyad通过为预训练大语言模型添加环境条件化的动作编码器来实现原生类型化决策，将决策分解为交互状态表示与环境特定动作语义，在冻结LLM、仅训练动作编码器的条件下即可在多个未见环境中获得一致的性能提升。
en_tdlr: Dyad augments pretrained LLMs with an environment-conditioned action encoder for native typed decision-making, factorizing decisions into interaction state representations and environment-specific action semantics, and achieves consistent gains in unseen environments by training only the action encoder while keeping the LLM frozen.
